invariants.rationale: Rotation in 90 degree increments is commonly non-negative; prevents negative rotations unless negative rotations are supported.
Common convention for rotations in 90-degree increments is 0 (none), 1 (90), 2 (180), 3 (270), suggesting an upper bound on rotation.
As an int parameter, rotation is always an integer; this asserts it for clarity with respect to increments.
If only values 0-3 are accepted, then rotation modulo 4 should equal rotation itself.
